description: This file implements a tuner interface for digital video broadcasting (DVB) using Linux DVB API. It includes classes and functions for managing tuner hardware, tuning parameters, filtering sections, and handling tuner states within the WPEFramework project. It also defines conversion tables for translating internal representations to Linux DVB API values.

classes.name: Tuner
classes.description: Represents a DVB tuner device, managing hardware interaction, tuning, filtering, and state monitoring within the WPEFramework environment.

classes.name: Tuner::Information
classes.description: Singleton class holding configuration and capabilities information about the tuner system, including supported standards and features.

classes.name: Tuner::Observer
classes.description: A thread class that monitors tuner status changes and manages registered tuner callbacks.

classes.name: Tuner::MuxFilter
classes.description: Handles filtering of MPEG sections on a specific PID and table ID, managing the demux device and data buffering.

classes.name: Tuner::Config
classes.description: JSON configuration container for tuner settings such as frontends, decoders, standard, annex, modus, scan, and callsign.

methods.name: Tuner::Convert
methods.description: Template function to convert between internal and Linux DVB API enumeration values.

methods.name: Tuner::Property
methods.description: Sets a dvb_property with specified command and value.

methods.name: Tuner::IndexToFrontend
methods.description: Converts an index to a combined adapter and frontend identifier.

methods.name: Tuner::Tuner
methods.description: Constructor initializing the tuner device, opening device files, and setting parameters.

methods.name: Tuner::~Tuner
methods.description: Destructor cleaning up resources, unregistering observers, and closing device files.

methods.name: Tuner::Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate a Tuner object based on configuration string.

methods.name: Tuner::Tune
methods.description: Configures the tuner hardware to lock onto a specified frequency, modulation, symbol rate, FEC, and inversion.

methods.name: Tuner::Filter
methods.description: Sets up or removes a section filter for a specific PID and table ID, with a callback for section data.

methods.name: Tuner::Dispatch
methods.description: Checks the tuner status and updates internal state, removing filters if necessary.
